review_candidates.title: Product Owner
review_candidates.description: About us: Where elite tech talent meets world-class opportunities! At Xenon7, we work with leading enterprises and innovative startups on exciting, cutting-edge projects that leverage the latest technologies across various domains of IT including Data, Web, Infrastructure, AI, and many others. Our expertise in IT solutions development and on-demand resources allows us to partner with clients on transformative initiatives, driving innovation and business growth. Whether it's empowering global organizations or collaborating with trailblazing startups, we are committed to delivering advanced, impactful solutions that meet today’s most complex challenges. Job Summary: This hybrid role combines strategic product ownership with deep business systems analysis to join the Xenon7 Core Team. In this strategic hybrid role, you will act as a key driver across our internal core initiatives and high-impact client engagements within the Banking & Financial Services practice. You will bridge high-level strategy, business requirements, and technical execution, owning product backlogs, leading requirements discovery, and designing workflows across non-core banking systems, data pipelines, and digital platforms. A. Product Ownership & Backlog Management Backlog Leadership: Own, structure, and prioritize the product backlog for core Xenon7 platform solutions and key delivery practices, balancing feature value, tech debt, and strategic goals. Story & Requirement Definition: Author clear, actionable User Stories complete with robust Acceptance Criteria (BDD/Gherkin) alongside formal BRDs/FRDs when navigating structured SDLC governance. Agile Execution: Lead sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, and sprint demos in collaboration with engineering teams, data architects, and QA leads. Release Approval: Define acceptance criteria, validate delivered features, and hold sign-off authority for production releases. B. Business & Systems Analysis Workflow Automation & Optimization: Analyze complex operational processes, identify bottlenecks, and architect TO-BE automated solutions using enterprise platforms like ServiceNow, JIRA, and custom software stack implementations. Systems & Data Integration: Conduct gap analysis for enterprise non-core banking platforms (CRM, ECM, HR systems) and define system interface specifications, data flows, and REST API mappings. Practice Standards: Establish and champion BA/PO best practices, documentation templates, and requirement-gathering frameworks across the Xenon7 delivery organization. C. Strategic & Regulatory Alignment Financial Domain Expertise: Translate complex banking standards and regulations—such as Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) frameworks, IFRS 9, AML/KYC, and Basel compliance—into actionable product specifications. Stakeholder Management: Serve as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor to internal executive leaders and key client counterparts, translating complex business needs into technical solutions. D. Data Analytics & Quality Assurance Data Insights: Utilize SQL, Power BI, and Tableau to profile datasets, validate functionality, and build executive-level delivery and performance dashboards. UAT Governance: Define test strategy, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), review QA test scenarios, and manage defect resolution to guarantee enterprise-grade delivery. Requirements Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, or hybrid BA/PO within Banking background is a must Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of enterprise systems (CRM, ECM, HR platforms, ServiceNow) and financial compliance/regulatory frameworks. Technical Toolset: Proficiency in JIRA, Confluence, and ServiceNow. Strong working knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, and SQL for data analysis. Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices architectures, and database design. Agile Mastery: Hands-on experience driving product delivery in Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid delivery models. Languages: Advanced bilingual communication skills in Arabic and English (written and spoken). Preferred Certifications Product Ownership: Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), CSPO, or Agile BA. Business Analysis: Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) or PMI-PBA.

review_candidates.title: Senior Merchant Acquisition
review_candidates.description: • Own merchant acquisition by actively identifying and approaching new potential merchants across different segments. • Conduct ongoing field activities, including visiting businesses, prospecting, networking, and creating new opportunities from the ground up. • Build and continuously expand a strong pipeline of potential merchants through proactive door-to-door acquisition. • Identify decision-makers, open conversations, understand their business needs, and introduce Vondera’s solutions. • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting and first contact to negotiation, closing, and onboarding. • Follow up with merchants who register through Vondera’s website and convert inbound opportunities into successful deals. • Balance inbound leads with proactive outbound acquisition, with a primary focus on generating new merchant pools independently. • Develop strong relationships with merchants and identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling where relevant. • Maintain accurate pipeline updates, activities, forecasts, and sales reports. • Consistently achieve and exceed monthly merchant acquisition and revenue targets. What We’re Looking For • 3+ years of experience in B2B sales, merchant acquisition, field sales, SaaS, fintech, e-commerce, or a related industry. • Proven track record in hunting and acquiring new merchants. • Strong field-sales mindset and willingness to be continuously on the ground meeting potential clients. • Excellent prospecting, negotiation, presentation, and closing skills. • Strong ability to open doors and create opportunities from zero. • Target-driven, energetic, persistent, and self-motivated. • Strong communication and relationship-building skills. • Ability to understand business needs and translate them into commercial solutions. • Comfortable working independently while contributing to a high-performance commercial team. The Mindset We’re Looking For We’re not looking for someone who waits for leads. We’re looking for a hunter. Someone who can walk into a business, open the door, start the conversation, build trust, create the opportunity, and close the deal. If you believe you can build your own merchant pipeline and consistently turn cold doors into business opportunities, we’d love to hear from you.

review_candidates.title: Account Manager (MENA - Arabic speaker)
review_candidates.description: *Resume MUST be in English Location: Remote - MENA Role: Account Manager Department: Sales Mode: Full-time About Respond.io Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place. Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale. We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management! Our Culture At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here's what we stand for: Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value! The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast. 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first. Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward! Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together. Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We're a team! Role Description We're hiring our Founding Account Manager for MENA to build respond.io's Account Management function from the ground up. This is a Day 0 role. There is no existing playbook, no fixed KPIs, and no template to follow. You will work directly with the Head of Department to design how we engage, retain, and grow our self-service customers and small key accounts across the region. You will spend roughly 70% of your time on our self-service cohort — customers who today have never spoken to a human at respond.io — and 30% on a small portfolio of high-potential key accounts . Your job is to move the self-service base from "unmanaged" to "observed and engaged", run monthly engagement experiments, and surface what actually drives retention and expansion in your region. You will succeed in this role if you are energized by ambiguity, comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and excited to be part of a small founding team building something from scratch. The role WhatsApp is how business gets done in MENA, and MENA is one of our fastest-growing regions. A big share of our customers bought Respond without ever talking to a human. This changes with you. Your goal will be to work with our customers to help them expand, retain, and get more value from the platform through onboarding and best practices. This is a one-to-many role where you will learn how to make an impact at scale. This is an early-stage role. The Account Management function is young: we have a first version of the playbook and early results, but MENA is untouched. You’ll be the first AM in the region, working directly with the executive team, with real room to shape how the playbook evolves as it scales globally. This is a commercial role. You grow revenue from existing customers and stop revenue from leaving. If you want to own a number and build the machine others will later operate, keep reading. What you’ll do Grow the base Own expansion revenue: usage growth, plan upgrades, monthly-to-annual conversions, multi-location rollouts. Find adoption opportunities - help our customers deploy best practices, use AI agents, more platform features. Work from usage and billing signals, because that is where expansion actually converts. Run activation rescue on accounts that bought but never fully deployed. Defend the base Spot at-risk behavior early and intervene before the cancellation, not after. Analyze every cancellation: find the root cause, document it, and share it with product and revenue leadership. Stabilize high-potential accounts that currently have no dedicated point of contact. Log every account touch from day one. We measure AM impact with data, and your results will be provable, not anecdotal. What we’re looking for 2+ years in B2B SaaS AM, CS, or Sales where you held a revenue, expansion, or retention number. Managed a portfolio of 50–100 accounts and know how to focus on the ones that matter most. Fluent English and Spanish; Portuguese a strong plus. Deep familiarity with MENA business culture and the role WhatsApp plays in it. Data-driven by default; fixes broken things without being asked; comfortable operating where the playbook is still being written. Comfortable working regional coverage hours. What’s in it for you Founding role with direct exposure to the executive team and real influence over the function’s design. Clear growth path: build the MENA playbook and have a team built around you. Base plus variable tied to expansion revenue and retention performance. The ownership of an early-stage role, backed by a profitable and well-funded company. Flexible, remote-friendly environment built for sustainable performance.
